# Exclusive Fallout 76 event in London: I'm invited

![Exclusive Fallout 76 Event in London: I'm Invited](/uploads/425_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

An exclusive **Fallout 76 Event** will take place in **London** on November 12th, 2024, where content creators and press can see and test some new features.

The community management of Bethesda Germany asked Nuka Knights and me whether I would like to be there. At first I was completely surprised and speechless. I didn't expect that. Yes, of course I want to be there!

Unfortunately, all invited content creators and journalists will not be able to tell you what we saw until December. However, we are allowed to report on the event itself and also publish a few pictures of it. 

**Developers** from **Bethesda** will also be present at the event and there will even be a small Q&A session. **Questions about Fallout 76** can be asked here and I'm currently collecting ideas for suitable questions.

**Feel free to leave suggestions for questions for Bethesda in the comments.**

The journey starts on Monday November 11th, 2024. So I will show you some pictures during my stay in London. You can also keep an eye on the Nuka Knights social media accounts (see footer of the website).

We can all be very excited about what awaits us.

Photo by Luke Stackpoole on Unsplash
